description: The statements the drawings persistence rules (.semgrep/cv-drawings-*) report with nosemgrep disabled: the four unscoped by design, each with a reviewed annotation in the source (CI-SEC-006). tools/ci/check_drawings_exception_sites.py compares a scan with this list, so a fifth unscoped statement needs an entry here, reviewed under C-10.1 (this list is not a C-10.2 path; docs/plan/security/ci-gates-e14.md); an annotation moved to another statement of its file fails the semgrep-bandit job, in that check or the whole-tree scan.
